bio: One of Lamron's bosses who forced Lil Durk to become a Black Disciple. He was considered an elder to Lil Durk and Lil Reese.
Close to OTF and Lil Durk.
Lil Jojo of Brick$quad 069 often targeted him before dying.
Close to Lil Moe and Dart of ABM.
Racketed by Bob-O of THF 46 and MTV. From Doggpound.
Close to Chief Keef, often backing him in fights, especially against STL.EBT. Focused on money-making rather than violence, and racketed members including Lil Jojo, CantGetRight, Scrapp, and Lil Jay.
Incarcerated for the murder of Duski of Hoola Gang.
An OG of ICG.
Killed in 2019 by his allies. Originally from ABM.
From Killaward 078, incarcerated for the murder of V12 of LOC City.
PBG represents Mosey World in his honor.
Close to King Shoota of TFG.
Incarcerated for the murder of AJ of LOC City.
In his honor, they represent Pooh Bear Gang.
Started with Saint Lawrence Boyz in the 1980s, arrested in the 1990s for three murders.
Racketed Ahunna Stacks of GVG.
PBG adopted the name Pep Boiz in his honor.
Racketed Baby of LOC City.
They adopted the name Henno Gang in his honor.
Incarcerated for the murder of his mother-in-law and attempted murder of his girlfriend's family.
Close to Lil Herb.
Part of Glo Gang and close to Lil Herb.
Racketed OTF Rex of Lamron.
